# Copilot instructions

- Keep the portfolio design premium, minimal, cinematic and dark.
- Use placeholders for media assets and contact links that can be replaced later.
- Prefer reusable, well-structured components and editable portfolio data managed through the Firebase admin panel.
- Maintain editable SEO metadata in `index.html`.
- Keep the site ready for Firebase Storage content in the future.
- Do not invent fake clients, metrics, or awards.
